caption:
Wish you could just run and hide? The place you flee to, He's already there. (Amos 9:8 devotional)

There's no hiding from Him — but He does not utterly destroy; He keeps a remnant. He is there too, in the very place you wanted to hide.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where am I trying to hide — from others, from myself, from God?
